parse.title: Match and Keep
parse.wikitext:
{{Event Header|Event-MatchAndKeep.png}} {{E|Match and Keep}} is a shrine [[Event]] encountered in all [[Acts]]. Shrine events appear less frequently than other events. == Options == {{Frame|Play}} * Play a matching game for cards. Match pairs of cards to add them to your deck. There is always a pair of one {{QueryLink|Cards|color:Colorless|Colorless}} card and one {{QueryLink|Cards|type:Curse|Curse}}. == Dialogue ==
A gremlin is madly shuffling cards on a table. This monster seems to be a harmless one. You approach him out of curiosity.
Before selecting {{Frame|Play}}
"{{TS|blue||Twelve}} cards! Match them to keep them! {{TS|blue||Five}} tries, no do-overs.
Are you ready? Let's start!"
After {{Frame|Play}}
You complete the gremlin's game and look up.
He disappeared?
